name: Parallel Voxel Carving for Multi-view Stereo
aliases: GPU-based Scalable Volumetric Reconstruction for Multi-view Stereo
definition: A scalable volumetric reconstruction algorithm for multi-view stereo that uses a GPU to simultaneously execute a large number of threads, each performing voxel carving to integrate depth maps with images from multiple views.
summary: Parallel Voxel Carving is a GPU-accelerated volumetric reconstruction algorithm that integrates multi-view depth maps into a 3D voxel grid, offering scalability and avoiding mesh intersection issues by outputting surface voxels with normals.
